decisions.reason: Custom earmolds for in-ear systems are a core competence of this established hearing-acoustics supplier, and the product has only been mentioned on the website so far, which suggests a low-cost offering with little reason to withdraw it within a year.
The individual EARsleeve for universal in-ear hearing systems has its own page and fits a growing market, making it a strategic complement to the firm's earmold business.
Vacuum thermoforming units are long-lifecycle equipment in the firm's dental and lab-device line, so they are typically kept for many years after launch.
